test_unary_unary_rpc: test the FirstServiceServicer unary-unary RPC invocation and verify response status code is OK
test_unary_stream_rpc: test the FirstServiceServicer unary-stream RPC invocation and verify trailing metadata and status code
test_stream_unary_rpc: test the FirstServiceServicer stream-unary RPC by sending multiple requests then closing and verifying response
test_stream_stream_rpc: test the FirstServiceServicer stream-stream RPC by sending requests and taking responses then verifying all match
